[P3] Document simpler alternatives for the added harness

Rule 2, “Simplify before you add,” requires the description to identify simpler options considered and explain why they do not work when logic is added. This introduces a label-indexed barrier harness and callback wrapper, but the description lists coverage and validation without that comparison. Existing OTel e2e tests already exercise branch isolation and replay, making the boundary between extending existing coverage and adding this harness worth establishing. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and record the alternatives and the reason for the chosen minimum approach.
